backgroundArt.preparation: Cover-fit to 1920x1080 with Lanczos 3 (1.148x, 0.6 px cropped vertically); hub-meadow-beach sky pixels shifted row by row to the original's sky colour at that height, weighted by closeness to the row's sky colour, since the generator drew the gradient steeper than the original; WebP quality 95, opaque.

hdArt.prompt: Make a faithful higher-resolution version of exactly the attached sprite on a transparent background: same framing and share of the canvas, silhouette, pose, expression, every part and its count, outline weight, colours and lighting; improve only crisp edges and fine surface detail; no added, removed, moved or restyled parts, no text, background, ground, shadow, glow or frame. Each file named its subject and the style of its set (flat chunky vector mascot with an even dark navy outline; glossy iridescent scallop shells; a scalloped shell dish with a gold rim and a pearly bowl).
hdArt.source: Raw PNGs (1254x1254, 1024x1024 for yawn, 1536x1024 for the tray), prompts, Codex logs and the processing scripts retained outside public in D:/CoreWise/_artifacts/CoreWiseLearn/hd-everything-r2 (raw/<name>-1.png; one attempt each was kept)
hdArt.preparation: Alpha under 12 and specks removed; each result laid over its original by the scale and offset that match it most closely, then scaled per axis so its outline meets the original edges exactly (the mascot keeps its feet where FEET in src/ui/mascot.ts expects them, within 1 of 512 units vertically); resized there with Lanczos 3; each colour channel matched to the original mean and spread. Mascot 768x768 PNG, 256-colour palette, dither 0.5; shells (coral 514x529, mint 507x526) and tray (767x296) WebP quality 80 with alpha quality 50.

frogPondArt.prompt: Every sprite prompt locked the house style (flat chunky vector, thick even dark navy outline, flat saturated fills, one soft highlight per part, simple faces with dark eyes, a white shine dot and pink cheeks), a fully transparent square canvas, one centred subject filling about 80 percent, and no text, letters, numbers or logos; the lily pads asked for a plain flat centre for a word, the hopscotch for blank squares, the laptop for blank keys. The pond asked for an opaque 16:9 calm pond with mostly empty open water in the middle and a clear bottom centre.
frogPondArt.attempts: One attempt each, except: frog-open (the first, frog-tongue, had a long tongue sticking up and a smaller frog; replaced by an open mouth so the game draws the tongue), cw-zipline (the first was thin and hard to read when small).
frogPondArt.source: Raw 1254x1254 RGBA PNGs (frog-sit 1024x1024; pond 1672x941 opaque) and prompts retained outside public in D:/CoreWise/_artifacts/CoreWiseLearn/frog-pond-art
frogPondArt.preparation: Sprites: alpha under 12 cleared, cropped to the alpha bounds, longest side fitted to 410 px (80 percent) centred on a 512x512 transparent canvas with Lanczos 3; frog-open and frog-puff instead take frog-sit's scale and foot line, matched by the width of the feet, so swapping poses does not shift the frog. Pond: cover-fit to 1920x1080 with Lanczos 3, opaque. WebP quality 92 with alpha quality 100 for sprites, quality 95 for the pond. Done with a scratch sharp script in place of scripts/prepare-art.mjs, which writes PNG and fits backgrounds within 1366x768.
